endpoint_availability_rule.query: one GIFT_checklists_raw call using exactly all 596 frozen confirmatory list_IDs
endpoint_availability_rule.unavailable_list: frozen list_ID absent from returned species rows
endpoint_availability_rule.retained_entity: at least one frozen list_ID returns species rows AND the union of returned lists contains at least one accepted high-confidence native row of any species
endpoint_availability_rule.excluded_entity: no available list OR zero accepted high-confidence native rows across all available frozen lists

presence_semantics.focal_entity_presence: focal work_ID appears in at least one accepted row across available frozen lists of the retained entity
presence_semantics.focal_entity_absence: focal work_ID absent from all accepted rows across available frozen lists of the retained entity

scoring.predictions: original v1.60 frozen predictions only; no refit or replacement
scoring.within_block: mean C-minus-R3 binary log-loss over retained entity-by-focal-species cells
scoring.across_blocks: equal-weight mean of retained confirmatory archipelago block means
scoring.empty_block: drop if no retained entity remains; no replacement

anti_rescue: fresh GIFT terminal v1.76 status is unchanged
no list/entity threshold may be chosen from C-minus-R3 direction
no species-universe, model, prediction, regional-pool, or block changes
this result cannot count as fresh or primary confirmatory evidence
